মুরগি.definition: মুরগি(Murgi) means Chicken. Someone [lacking]. [courage] and bravery. [Unskilled], stupid, afraid, loser, coward.
মুরগি.example: শালা, তুই একটা মুরগি অই। ([Bastard], you [really] are [a chicken].)

মধু.definition:
madhu is the most genuine kind hearted person i know. He is always full of energy and always laughing. He is so [sweet and innocent] and always there for you. He makes a miserable sad room turn happy and makes everyone around her happy. He is extremely smart and can always help you no matter what.

He is an amazing [best friend] and if you find him [don’t let him go]!!
‘madhu is so smart’
